launch_slurm_job: submit a FairChem job to a SLURM cluster using submitit with AutoExecutor and scheduler config
launch_local_job: launch a FairChem job locally using torch elastic launch or single process mode
run_slurm_spmd_program: run a SPMD program on SLURM with distributed setup, seed initialization, and checkpoint support
map_job_to_dist_config: convert a FairChem JobConfig into a distributed training config with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a SLURM job submission from runner state to prevent re-submission on node failure
